name: Protection Over Satan
overview: Scripture reveals that God's faithful servants are under His protective care against the attacks of Satan and all adversaries. Those who dwell in the secret place of the Most High abide under His shadow and receive His lovingkindness and righteousness, which sustains and defends them (Psalms 36:10; 91:1). The Lord promises that no weapon formed against His people will prosper, affirming the believer's victory through His righteousness (Isaiah 54:17). This protection is further symbolized in the armor of God, where salvation and the Word of God serve as a helmet and sword to resist spiritual assault (Ephesians 6:17), just as Jesus, empowered by the Holy Spirit, overcame temptation in the wilderness (Luke 4:1).
